relationships.subject: HwTx-IV
relationships.evidence_quote: Neurotoxin site 4 ligands like HwTx-IV and ProTx-II inhibit NaV1.7 by trapping VS2 in the resting state, thereby preventing channel activation until a more positive membrane potential is reached.

relationships.subject: m3-HwTx-IV
relationships.evidence_quote: These results show that the binding of m3-HwTx-IV inhibits the NaVAb/NaV1.7-VS2A chimeric channel by trapping it in the resting state

key_findings: Cryo-EM structure shows tarantula toxin m3-HwTx-IV trapping Nav1.7 VS2 in the resting state via a lysine 'stinger' penetrating a triad of carboxyl groups in the S3-S4 loop.
High-affinity binding occurs only in the resting state; partially activated VS2 gives low-affinity complexes.
